item.title: Brigitte Bardot, 1960s French sex symbol turned militant animal rights activist, dies at 91
item.description: Brigitte Bardot, 1960s French sex symbol turned militant animal rights activist, dies at 91 PARIS (AP) — Brigitte Bardot, the French 1960s sex symbol who became one of the greatest screen sirens of the 20th century and later a militant animal rights activist and far-right supporter, has died. She was 91. Bardot died Sunday at her home in southern France,...
